title: Vaporesso Luxe QS Pod Vape Kit
description: The Luxe QS from Vaporesso is a sleek, elegant and super-compact vape device that can easily last a full day of use thanks to an impressive 1000mAh internal battery . The Luxe QS is as luxurious as it sounds, with an eye-catching textured holographic surface that feels great in the hand while being sweatproof and smudge-resistant. The Vaporesso Luxe QS is light and compact enough to carry with you anywhere you go, and can easily slip into any pocket, bag, or compartment. When it’s time to recharge the Luxe QS pod kit, the USB-C type connection will get your Vaporesso Luxe QS up to a full charge in less than an hour. With the Luxe QS there are no buttons or settings to adjust. To operate you simply draw on the device to vape. This auto-draw feature mimics drawing on a traditional cigarette, thus making the Luxe QS an excellent device for newer vapers finding their feet with vaping. The refillable QS pods come with a 1.2ohm mesh coil pre-installed for a intensely satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) style-draw, or a pre-installed 0.8ohm mesh coil for a slightly airier, restricted DL (direct lung) sensation. Both pods and coils provide exceptional flavour and when it’s time to refill, Vaporesso’s SSS leakproof technology and top-filling port ensure mess-free refilling. When the pod’s coil reaches the end of its life you simply replace the whole pod. You can even adjust the airflow on the Luxe QS by turning the pod around 180 degrees for an airier or tighter vape. The Vaporesso Luxe QS is a simple to use 20W pod kit with long battery life and a super-stylish holographic textured finish. Ideal for use with Classic/High PG , 50/50, and Nicotine Salts e-liquids. Browse our vape liquid and find the perfect flavour to match this kit. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
